Text: The Journey of Faith
Heading: A Spiral, Not a Ladder
Text: Spiritual growth is rarely linear. We receive, question, seek, rebuild, …
blocks.value: Spiritual growth is rarely linear. We receive, question, seek, rebuild, embody, and awaken - often more than once. No stage is a rank, and no stage makes anyone more loved by God.

blocks.label: Text: The stages describe how our relationship to faith may change - not God's…
blocks.value: The stages describe how our relationship to faith may change - not God's relationship to us. Jesus remains at the center of the journey.

Text: Where You Are
Heading: You are not failing. You are becoming honest.
blocks.value: You are not failing. You are becoming honest.

blocks.label: Text: The questions may be intellectual, emotional, moral, or deeply personal.…
blocks.value: The questions may be intellectual, emotional, moral, or deeply personal. Sometimes the hardest part is not the question itself, but the fear of what asking it might cost.

blocks.label: Text: One common risk is believing you must solve everything quickly - or carr…
blocks.value: One common risk is believing you must solve everything quickly - or carry the questions alone. The invitation is to tell the truth in the presence of God and trustworthy people, without forcing a conclusion before it is ready.

blocks.label: Heading: Your questions may be a form of faithfulness.
blocks.value: Your questions may be a form of faithfulness.

blocks.label: Text: Love of truth can require the courage to question answers that no longer…
blocks.value: Love of truth can require the courage to question answers that no longer hold.

blocks.label: Heading: Grief often travels with doubt.
Text: You may be mourning certainty, community, identity, or a picture of God …
blocks.value: You may be mourning certainty, community, identity, or a picture of God that once made life feel safer.

blocks.label: Heading: You do not owe anyone a rushed answer.
blocks.value: You do not owe anyone a rushed answer.

blocks.label: Text: Some questions need study. Others need healing, time, or a new experienc…
blocks.value: Some questions need study. Others need healing, time, or a new experience of God.

blocks.label: Heading: Honesty needs companionship and practice.
Text: Safe people and simple prayer keep questions connected to relationship r…
blocks.value: Safe people and simple prayer keep questions connected to relationship rather than isolation.

blocks.label: Text: A Practice for This Season
Heading: Honest Prayer
Text: Bringing your whole truth into God's presence.
blocks.value: Bringing your whole truth into God's presence.

blocks.label: Heading: Arrive
Text: Take one slow breath. Pray: “God, here is what is true.”
blocks.value: Take one slow breath. Pray: “God, here is what is true.”

blocks.label: Heading: Name

blocks.value: Say or write the question, feeling, or disappointment without softening it for God.

blocks.label: Heading: Ask

blocks.value: What do you need? What do you wish God would do? Let the prayer be specific and unfinished.

blocks.label: Heading: Notice & Rest
Text: Notice any thread of trust or longing that remains. Close with silence o…
blocks.value: Notice any thread of trust or longing that remains. Close with silence or: “I believe; help my unbelief.”

blocks.label: Text: WORDS YOU CAN BORROW

blocks.value: Try this for seven days: write one honest sentence each day. The aim is not certainty. It is relationship.
